# UltraTextGen

> Turn plain text into 88 Unicode fonts — bold, italic, cursive, gothic, bubble, small caps, aesthetic, upside-down and Zalgo. Copy and paste straight into Instagram bios, TikTok captions, Discord names, LinkedIn headlines, and WhatsApp. Free, instant, no sign-up.

UltraTextGen is a free, no-sign-up text tool: Unicode font styles to copy and paste, a browsable symbol and emoji library, one reference page per individual symbol, printable lettering and handwriting sheets rendered in the browser, and explanatory guides and answers. Everything runs client-side.

4872 indexable pages in 32 languages. This file is a navigation index, not a URL list: https://ultratextgen.com/sitemap.xml is the complete canonical URL list and stays the authority on what exists. Links below point to a narrower llms.txt index where one exists, and straight to a page where it does not.

English pages are served from the site root, so this file is also the English index (https://ultratextgen.com/en/llms.txt redirects here). Every other language has its own index at https://ultratextgen.com/<code>/llms.txt.

The "Jobs across languages" section lists the site's main jobs. Each line is the English page for one job, then the same page in every other language it exists in, so one read answers which page does a job in a given language.

## Main generator

- [Fancy Text Generator](https://ultratextgen.com/): Type once, get 88 Unicode fonts you can copy and paste anywhere: Instagram bios, TikTok captions, Discord names, LinkedIn headlines…

## Sections (English)

- [Font styles (Categories)](https://ultratextgen.com/category/llms.txt): Explore all Unicode font categories. Find bold, cursive, gothic, bubble, strikethrough, and more. Discover what each font signals and where to use it for maximum impact. 26 pages.
- [Use-case generators (Use Cases)](https://ultratextgen.com/usecase/llms.txt): Pick the social media tool that matches your moment: comment fonts, bio fonts, LinkedIn headlines, emoji combinations and more, each built for one use case. 42 pages.
- [Symbol & emoji library (Library)](https://ultratextgen.com/library/llms.txt): Browse the UltraTextGen Library, an A–Z directory of 339 reference collections covering Unicode symbols, emoji, and formatting guides. 376 pages.
- [Individual symbols (Symbols)](https://ultratextgen.com/symbol/llms.txt): Look up one symbol at a time: meaning, history, how to type it, and where it's safe to use. Browse individual symbol pages, or see the full category libraries. 118 pages.
- [Printables](https://ultratextgen.com/printables/llms.txt): Printable tracing worksheets, name sheets, coloring pages, word puzzles and block letters. Each prints as a PDF or saves as a PNG, with a class set option. 220 pages.
- [Seasonal & event text (Events)](https://ultratextgen.com/events/llms.txt): Live font, emoji, kaomoji, ASCII art and phrase generators for holidays: Chinese New Year, Eid, Christmas, Diwali, Halloween, Valentine's Day and more. 17 pages.
- [Guides](https://ultratextgen.com/guide/llms.txt): Fonts are not decoration. They are signals. Explore guides on how Unicode typography encodes tone, authority, irony, and emphasis across social platforms. 33 pages.
- [Learn](https://ultratextgen.com/learn/llms.txt): UltraTextGen's education library: stage-by-stage, tool-connected guides for parents and teachers. First topic: teaching handwriting, from readiness to cursive. 18 pages.
- [Answers](https://ultratextgen.com/answers/llms.txt): Direct answers to common font and typography questions for Facebook, Snapchat, LinkedIn, and more — exact font details, lookalikes, and practical guidance. 66 pages.
- [Updates](https://ultratextgen.com/updates/llms.txt): What changed and why it matters for your text: new Unicode versions, platform formatting changes, and game nickname rule changes we track. 13 pages.

## Text tools

- [ASCII Art Generator](https://ultratextgen.com/ascii-art-generator/): Type a word or name and turn it into big multi-line block-letter ASCII art, with several font styles.
- [ASCII Converter](https://ultratextgen.com/ascii-converter/): Turn text into decimal, hex, binary and octal codes as you type, or paste codes to decode them back into text.
- [Calligraphy Font Generator](https://ultratextgen.com/calligraphy/): Type once and get your text back in eight calligraphic hands: formal script, bold script, blackletter and chancery italic.
- [Character Counter & Word Counter](https://ultratextgen.com/character-counter/): Free character and word counter with live stats.
- [Characters to Words Converter](https://ultratextgen.com/character-counter/characters-to-words/): Convert any character count to words and pages instantly.
- [Curved & Arc Text Generator](https://ultratextgen.com/curved-text/): Bend text into 15 shapes, from arch and wave to spiral and heart, on one or more lines, then download it as SVG or PNG.
- [Fancy Letters A to Z](https://ultratextgen.com/fancy-letters/): The full alphabet (A–Z, a–z and 0–9) in 20 Unicode styles: bold, italic, script, gothic, double-struck, bubble, squared, small caps…
- [Hiragana Chart](https://ultratextgen.com/hiragana-chart/): All 46 basic hiragana with romaji: plus the voiced kana and combinations.
- [Image to ASCII Art Converter](https://ultratextgen.com/image-to-ascii/): Convert an image or photo to ASCII art in your browser.
- [Kaomoji Dictionary & Decoder](https://ultratextgen.com/kaomoji-dictionary/): Paste any text face to decode it: its name, meaning, mood, and a part-by-part breakdown of the eyes, mouth, and arms.
- [Kaomoji Generator](https://ultratextgen.com/kaomoji-generator/): Build your own Japanese text face: pick a mood, mix the parts, and copy it in one click.
- [Katakana Chart](https://ultratextgen.com/katakana-chart/): All 46 basic katakana with romaji: plus the voiced kana and combinations.
